name: Champs-Élysées
overview: The Champs-Élysées is perhaps the most famous avenue in the world, stretching 1.9 kilometers from Place de la Concorde to the Arc de Triomphe. Known as 'The World's Most Beautiful Avenue,' it's lined with theaters, cafés, luxury shops, and trees.
history: Originally fields and market gardens, the avenue was laid out in 1667 by André Le Nôtre as an extension of the Tuileries Garden. It became a fashionable promenade in the 18th century and evolved into the commercial and tourist destination it is today.
highlights: Luxury flagship stores (Louis Vuitton, Cartier, Chanel)
Christmas market and decorations in December
tips: Expensive for dining - better to walk and window shop. Visit during Toot Bus tour for commentary. Beautiful for evening strolls when illuminated. Avoid pickpockets in crowded areas.
